children: Richelieu Hardware said it acquired the hardware division of Penrod Company.
Richelieu said the acquisition of the door hardware and components distributor would create U.S. synergies for its existing Canadian offerings, and add around $70 million in annual sales.
Financial terms of the deal weren't disclosed.
